text:
alex: Pager: gen-queue EU region — spike in 5xx starting ~12:01 UTC. Investigating.
oncall-bot: Alert INC-8793 (P1) triggered; acknowledged by maya.
maya: Ack. Looking at /v1/generate in eu-west1 — ~15% 5xx, predominantly streaming connections. Logs show GPU queue backpressure + OOM-ish retries.
tj: Copy. Any confirmed user impact yet?
maya: Two customer tickets reported errors; external 502s observed for some streaming sessions. Seems like partial degradation for EU low-latency tier.
lina: @maya can you paste the runbook link and current infra metrics? I'll start a statuspage draft.
maya: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/genqueue-eu 
Metrics: genqueue pool-3 GPU mem ~92%, queued requests +220% vs baseline.
lina: Draft initial status (proposed):
```
Initial update — Investigating
We are investigating elevated error rates for generation requests in eu-west1 which may affect streaming responses. Our on-call team is actively mitigating; customers in the EU may experience increased errors or latency. We will post updates as we have them (next update in ~15 minutes).
```
statuspage-bot: Draft saved to /incidents/drafts/INC-8793-initial.txt :white_check_mark: 
ops-lead: Please add a short workaround line and fallback routing note. Also avoid root-cause language.
maya: Adding workaround: "Workaround: retry failed requests with exponential backoff. We are routing new sessions to west-europe-standard where capacity is available."
tj: I'll loop in CS to update customer tickets. @legal please quick-check copy before publish.
legal: Quick read — wording ok. Recommend not mentioning internal components or memory numbers publicly.
lina: Understood. Publishing initial now. @statuspage-bot publish public + internal ops channel.
statuspage-bot: Published initial update at 12:03 UTC — https://status.redwood.com/INC-8793
maya: Mitigation actions: scaled genqueue pool + adjusted cache eviction priority. Error rate dropped to ~7%. Continuing monitoring.
alex: Thanks. Keep updates short. Next planned update 12:18 UTC.
matt: CS: two customers impacted; both informed with mitigation note and ETA ~30m. Will escalate if new reports.
maya: 12:18 update: error rate ~2.3%, latency improving. Redirecting new sessions to fallback. No signs of data loss. Next update 12:40 or sooner if status changes.
lina: Draft 12:40 update: "We have reduced the error rate significantly by scaling resources and routing traffic; services are returning to normal. We continue to monitor and will run post-incident checks. If you continue to experience issues, contact Support."
ops-lead: LGTM. Prepare resolved copy with timeline + followup links.
maya: 12:52 mitigation: rollback of recent cache eviction patch; pressure cleared. Full traffic allowed back to eu-west1.
statuspage-bot: Published resolved notice at 13:02 UTC.
maya: Resolved — final summary: regression in cache eviction policy increased GPU memory pressure on genqueue, causing request queuing and 5xx responses. Rollback performed at 12:52 UTC; full recovery observed by ~12:58 UTC. RCA doc being created. :white_check_mark:
alex: Great work. Please add incident link and RCA stub to #postmortems and tag product/infra owners. Thanks everyone. :eyes:
